changelog: **MARKETING: no internship wording left on any surface a sales tenant can reach:** the MARKETING overlay (`src/i18n/verticalOverlays.ts`) now covers every remaining reachable string — landing, notifications, the feature catalogue, pricing, deals, the rep directory, newsletters, projects, empty states and more — in EN/TR/DE (lead / sales rep / account / deal). Nineteen internship-only namespaces that a MARKETING org cannot render (behind the `mentorship`/`sourcing` gates, the mentor shell, the portal or capability-gated mail sweeps) move into `LEAK_EXEMPT` with the gate that closes each. The leak ratchet in `scripts/check-i18n.ts` drops from en 398 · tr 401 · de 396 to **0 in every locale**, so any new internship word a MARKETING tenant could read fails CI.

en: The sales product now speaks only in leads, sales reps, accounts and deals — no mentoring or internship wording is left on its screens, e-mails or notifications.
tr: Satış ürünü artık yalnızca müşteri adayı, satış temsilcisi, hesap ve fırsat diliyle konuşuyor — ekranlarında, e-postalarında ve bildirimlerinde mentorluk ya da staj ifadesi kalmadı.
de: Das Vertriebsprodukt spricht jetzt nur noch von Leads, Vertriebsmitarbeitern, Accounts und Deals — auf Bildschirmen, in E-Mails und Benachrichtigungen ist keine Mentoring- oder Praktikumsformulierung mehr übrig.
